business_problem: Nationwide needed a safe, repeatable way to move generative AI from experimentation into production across a regulated financial-services environment without compromising governance, risk controls, or organizational readiness.
solution_summary: Nationwide partnered with IBM Consulting to build a society-wide AI strategy and operating model anchored in an AI Centre of Expertise powered by Microsoft Azure OpenAI Service. The CoE combines an operations team that manages the AI lifecycle, a cross-functional council that evaluates and approves use cases, and a delivery function that builds solutions with large language models and enterprise data. IBM helped Nationwide define technical patterns, training, communications, governance, and risk-management processes so new AI capabilities could be assessed and deployed through a common framework rather than project by project. With that foundation in place, Nationwide began developing practical solutions for contract management, quality assurance, operational reporting, and colleague support, including tools that help staff answer customer queries faster. The architecture is a governed operating layer for AI adoption across legal, procurement, technology, security, and data teams.

solution_components.name: IBM Consulting
solution_components.role: Helped Nationwide define the AI strategy, governance model, CoE design, and delivery principles for regulated AI adoption.

solution_components.name: Microsoft Azure OpenAI Service
solution_components.role: Provides the large language model platform used by the AI Centre of Expertise to build and pilot solutions.

data_flow: Enterprise data and candidate use cases enter the AI Centre of Expertise, where cross-functional governance reviews them, Azure OpenAI Service powers solution development, and approved patterns are delivered back into operational roles such as contract management, reporting, and customer-support workflows.
business_outcome: Nationwide established the governance, skills, and technical foundation needed to scale AI responsibly in a member-owned bank and began turning that foundation into practical operational and customer-service use cases.
